reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for melatonin or any supplement. For that, a doctor or pharmacist is the right person, especially if you take any medication or have a health condition.

As for recovery, melatonin isn't a recovery tool in itself. It's a sleep-timing aid, and sleep is where recovery happens. Before reaching for anything, I'd look at the basics: a consistent bedtime and wake time, a dark and cool room, and no hard training or caffeine late in the day.

If your sleep is still poor after that, bring it to your doctor and they can say whether melatonin makes sense for you. Want me to look at how your training load has been stacking up lately, in case that's part of it?
